dedupeText: mid century anniversary album design duotone cyan script typography split composition portrait 1950s style anniversary high contrast portraiture against a minimalist white sidebar large light blue numeral acting as a background layer for dark text cyan tinted monochrome photography harmonizing with light blue graphic elements vertical alignment of text within the right hand white space combine a high contrast duotone portrait left 60 with a white typographic sidebar right 40 layer a large pale graphic numeral behind dark elegant script text and anchor the composition with wide tracked italic serif text at the base

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a high-contrast, cyan-tinted duotone portrait on the left and a clean white typographic column on the right. The design uses large-scale numeral overlays and elegant script lettering to create a sense of legacy and celebration.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast portraiture against a minimalist white sidebar
Large, light-blue numeral acting as a background layer for dark text
Cyan-tinted monochrome photography harmonizing with light blue graphic elements
Vertical alignment of text within the right-hand white space
coreInvariants: Cyan/Teal duotone color treatment for the photograph
Strict vertical division between image and text areas
Layered typography where script text sits atop a large graphic numeral

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up profile portrait occupies the left 60% of the frame, cropped tightly at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-blue numeral '30' in the right column serves as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move right to the large numeral, then follow the vertical text stack downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right 40% is primarily white negative space, providing breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-tinted duotone (shadows are deep teal, highlights are pale cyan).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white background in the right column.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light sky blue for the large graphic numeral.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal contrast in the portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant, slanted script and italicized serif.
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in the script elements
Italicized, widely spaced lowercase serif for the footer
Fluid, continuous loops in the display script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large numeral '30' rendered as a soft-edged, semi-transparent graphic shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, high-contrast script paired with a widely-spaced, understated italic serif.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast script style of the main name.
Provides the classic, elegant serif feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast profile portrait of a young man with styled hair, treated with a cyan/teal duotone filter. The image should occupy the left 60% of the frame, with the right 40% being a solid white vertical bar. Include a large, light-blue '30' numeral centered in the white bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a dark teal formal script over the top half of the '30'. Add the collection title in a smaller script below it. Place the final descriptive text in a widely-spaced, lowercase italic serif at the bottom of the white column.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait strictly duotone cyan/teal?
Is the right column pure white?
Is the bottom text lowercase with wide tracking?
Does the script text overlap the large numeral?

adjustableVariables: Duotone color tint (e.g., sepia instead of cyan)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the duotone doesn't lose facial detail in the shadows.
Check that the script text is legible against the light blue numeral.
Verify the tracking on the bottom text is sufficiently wide to feel intentional.
Confirm the vertical split is sharp and perfectly aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast duotone portrait [Left 60%] with a white typographic sidebar [Right 40%]. Layer a large, pale graphic numeral behind dark, elegant script text, and anchor the composition with wide-tracked italic serif text at the base.
